statement: The Federal Reserve raises its federal funds target range at a scheduled FOMC decision between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-06, lifting the target range upper bound by at least 25 basis points.
resolution: FRED daily series DFEDTARU shows its 2026-11-06 value at least 0.25 percentage points above its 2026-10-16 value, covering any FOMC decision between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-06.
failure_condition: DFEDTARU for 2026-11-06 is less than 0.25 percentage points above its 2026-10-16 value, whether from a hold, a cut, or no decision in the span.

statement: EIA daily Cushing WTI spot price prints at or above 120.00 USD on at least one date between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-31. Reference: WTI last 101.87 at packet seal 2026-09-16.
resolution: EIA series RWTC, Cushing OK WTI spot FOB, records any daily value at or above 120.00 USD dated 2026-09-17 through 2026-12-31 inclusive. Reference at seal: 101.87.
failure_condition: No RWTC daily value dated 2026-09-17 through 2026-12-31 reaches 120.00 USD.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds an entry for an Acronis product vulnerability with a dateAdded between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains at least one entry whose vendorProject or product field contains Acronis and whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming Acronis carries a dateAdded from 2026-09-16 through 2026-10-30.

statement: At least one putative class action over the CenterPoint Energy cyberattack and customer data theft is filed in a United States federal district court between 2026-09-17 and 2026-11-16.
resolution: A US federal district court docket on PACER shows a putative class action naming CenterPoint Energy as defendant, arising from the disclosed data breach, filed 2026-09-17 through 2026-11-16.
failure_condition: No such complaint with a filing date between 2026-09-17 and 2026-11-16 appears on any US federal district court docket.

statement: The United States Senate holds at least one recorded roll call vote on a joint or concurrent resolution directing removal of US armed forces from hostilities against Iran between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: Senate.gov or Congress.gov roll call records show such a vote, on any question including passage, discharge, tabling, or veto override, dated 2026-09-17 through 2026-12-18.
failure_condition: No Senate roll call on any Iran war powers measure carries a vote date between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-18.

statement: The European Council or the Council of the European Union adopts conclusions or a decision establishing or formally offering associate member status for Canada between 2026-09-17 and 2027-03-01.
resolution: Council conclusions or a Council decision published on consilium.europa.eu, dated 2026-09-17 through 2027-03-01, explicitly creates or offers an EU associate membership status for Canada.
failure_condition: No Council conclusions or decision adopted between 2026-09-17 and 2027-03-01 creates or offers Canadian associate membership; Commission proposals, speeches, and summit remarks do not qualify.

statement: GDACS lists at least one wildfire event in Indonesia at Orange or Red alert level with an event start or update date between 2026-09-17 and 2026-11-15.
resolution: The public GDACS feed shows a WF event for Indonesia at Orange or Red alert with a start or update date 2026-09-17 through 2026-11-15.
failure_condition: Every GDACS Indonesia wildfire entry dated 2026-09-17 through 2026-11-15 remains at Green alert, or no such entry exists.

statement: Saudi official channels acknowledge at least one Houthi-attributed drone or missile impact or interception over Saudi territory occurring between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-17.
resolution: Saudi Press Agency, the Saudi defense ministry, or Saudi civil defense acknowledges an impact or interception dated 2026-09-17 through 2026-10-17, and Reuters, AP, or AFP carries the acknowledgment by the deadline.
failure_condition: By the deadline no Saudi official acknowledgment carried by Reuters, AP, or AFP covers any Houthi-attributed impact or interception over Saudi territory dated in the event window.

statement: Commercial vessel transit through the Strait of Hormuz is suspended or effectively halted for at least 48 consecutive hours at any point between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: UKMTO advisories or Lloyds List document a suspension or effective halt of commercial Hormuz transit lasting 48 or more consecutive hours between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-31, corroborated by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: No documented 48-hour suspension of commercial Hormuz transit occurs between 2026-09-17 and 2026-12-31; reroutings, insurance surcharges, and pauses under 48 hours do not qualify.

statement: The US Department of Justice announces criminal charges against at least one named defendant over a Russia-directed plot to kill or injure a Ukrainian national outside Ukraine, between 2026-09-17 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: A justice.gov press release or an indictment unsealed on a federal docket, dated 2026-09-17 through 2027-01-15, charges at least one named person in such a plot.
failure_condition: No qualifying DOJ announcement or unsealed indictment dated between 2026-09-17 and 2027-01-15 exists by the deadline.
